screening_findings.early_hard_domains: At 165x159 and 163x161 with the fixed owned shape, failure now occurs at USB-JTAG seating before the legalizer: 0.283977083 and 0.299645459 seconds. This identifies incompatible earlier seating rather than falsely accepting a smaller board. These screens precede the refinement follow-through change, but terminate before refinement runs. Logs native/build/carrier-hard-domain-OUTLINE.log.
screening_findings.limitation: No statistically established performance claim, no matched Python comparison and no smaller accepted board. Early rejection is evidence for subsequent constrained-neighbour seating work, not proof of global infeasibility.
